user.title: Connect your inverter
user.description: Enter the local IP address of your GivEnergy inverter or data adapter. Energy Command Centre reads inverter, solar, grid, house and battery data directly over your local network.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect inverter
reconfigure.description: Update the local inverter connection. The default GivEnergy Modbus port is 8899.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to that IP address and port.
error.detection_failed: The device responded, but Energy Command Centre could not identify a supported GivEnergy inverter.
error.wrong_inverter: That address belongs to a different inverter. Remove and add the integration again to change inverter.
